primary_content.text: Want to enjoy a resort with first-row views of the sea, abundant food and leisure facilities on Bophut Beach? The Peace Resort in Koh Samui, which will be reopened with a new brand in January 2025, was originally a classic resort with a history of more than 1 years. It is located in the first row of Bophut Beach. After a comprehensive renovation, it officially became the NH Collection series under the Minor Hotel Group. It focuses on parent-child friendliness and offers a variety of room types from two-person world to family fun, as well as a super rich food and leisure facilities.

The classic resort is upgraded again, the first NH Collection Hotel in Thailand: Formerly the Samui Peace Resort which opened in 1977, it became a member of the NH Collection of the Minor Hotel Group in 2025. It is also the first selected hotel in Thailand, focusing on family-friendly room types and facilities, so that both adults and children can stay comfortably and have fun.

The spacious rooms and villas are all surrounded by palm trees: There are a total of 122 rooms, suites and villas in the hotel, each of which is surrounded by lush green palm trees. The main building offers large guest rooms and pool suites, as well as garden villas with private pools and beachfront pool villas, where you can enjoy a private and luxurious space.

There are all kinds of food and leisure facilities, which are fun for adults and children: The resort has an all-day restaurant serving local and exotic cuisine, as well as a poolside bar that provides light meals and drinks. In addition, there are abundant leisure facilities such as open-air swimming pool, massage pool, gymnasium, cinema room, youth and children's playground, etc.

The first row of sea views at Bophut Beach, close to Fisherman's Village and the Fortune Buddha: The resort is located on Bophut Beach in the north of Koh Samui, with a superb first-row seaside view. It is only a 15-minute drive from Samui International Airport. There is a fisherman's village with a night market nearby, as well as nearby attractions such as the Fortune Buddha and the Colorful Temple.

primary_content.text: Koh Samui is not a tourist island with colorful and lively nightlife. The sightseeing on the island is mainly based on marine activities, supplemented by tours of other natural landscapes. Tourists who come to visit Koh Samui from afar, it is highly recommended to directly choose four or five-star hotels. Enjoy the atmosphere and facilities of an island vacation in the hotel, and occasionally combine it with marine activities, night markets and scenic spots to form a very leisurely pure vacation itinerary.

The accommodation area on Koh Samui is divided by beaches, which can be divided into six beach areas, Chaweng Beach, Choeng Mon Beach, Maenam Beach, Bophut Beach, Lamai Beach, and Pan Khao Beach. Each beach has its own characteristics and regional characteristics. You can filter accommodations based on your vacation needs and preferences, and based on the beach area.
Chaweng Beach: The most lively commercial area and the longest white sandy beach on the island, Chaweng Street is the most lively place for nightlife on the island｜ Chaweng Beach Star Hotel
Choeng Mon Beach: A tranquil beach resort on the northeast corner of Koh Samui, with several luxury star resorts.
Mae Nam Beach: On the northern coastline of Koh Samui, next to Bophut Beach, overlooking Koh Phangan, famous for its full moon party.
Bophut Beach: The beach is only about 2 kilometers long, with a quiet environment away from the hustle and bustle, close to the Fisherman's Village Market and Fisherman's Wharf.

main_topic.h_title: Quick introduction: basic introduction to Koh Samui
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: Koh Samui (เกาะสมุย) is the third largest island in Thailand, second only to Phuket and Koh Chang. It is also nicknamed Coconut Island because of its abundance of coconuts, and its administrative area belongs to Surat Thani Province. After the official opening of Samui Airport in 1989, the tourism industry of Samui began to gradually develop. Due to its natural clean white beach and blue sky advantages, it is now a very popular tourist island. There is still a well-known Koh Phangan Island in the surrounding waters. ) And Koh Tao (Koh Tao) two islands.

Although the steep terrain of Koh Samui has beautiful beaches, the island’s central water storage capacity is weak due to high mountains, which makes the local water source insufficient. In addition, the island’s air routes are restricted by franchise and air routes cannot compete freely, making air fares impossible Significant reduction, the advantage is that the degree of commercialization is low, and the overall tourism environment can still maintain a fairly good appearance, especially the hotels built along the coast, most of which have beautiful beaches and blue sky views, which are quite suitable for people who like island hotel vacations.

main_topic.h_title: When traveling to Koh Samui, what's the most convenient way to choose accommodation?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: When it comes to choosing an accommodation area, the first thing to consider is your travel needs. If you enjoy a lively atmosphere with shopping malls, bars, and various restaurants right outside your door, Chaweng Beach is definitely the top choice, offering the best amenities and the most diverse hotel options. For a slightly quieter yet still convenient location, consider Lamai Beach, which is less expensive than Chaweng and has a more relaxed atmosphere. For families or couples, Bophut Beach is highly recommended. It's close to Fisherman's Village Walking Street, boasting an exotic and high-quality environment, making it convenient for shopping and dining. It has become a highly recommended destination in recent years.

main_topic.h_title: What is the approximate price range for recommended hotels in Koh Samui?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: Accommodation options in Koh Samui range widely, catering to various budgets. Generally, budget choices like backpacker hostels or simple guesthouses cost around NT$800-1,500 per night; mid-range boutique hotels or chain beachfront resorts typically cost between NT$3,000-6,000, and these usually offer excellent pools and breakfasts. For a luxurious experience, stay in a top-tier five-star hotel or a private villa, with a budget of NT$10,000 or more per night. It's advisable to utilize early bird discounts or member discounts on booking websites like Agoda, which can often save you a significant amount compared to booking on-site.

main_topic.h_title: What are some family-friendly hotel options suitable for families with children?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: When looking for family-friendly hotels, it's recommended to prioritize resorts with private beaches and kids' clubs. The calmer waves at Cheong Muong Beach in northern Koh Samui make it perfect for children to play in the water. Many large hotels offer complimentary family-friendly facilities such as playrooms, water slides, and even babysitting services. When browsing booking websites, check for policies allowing children under 12 to stay free if they don't occupy a bed. Additionally, choosing a family suite with a kitchen is a smart option, making it easy to prepare simple meals for the children and allowing the whole family to enjoy a carefree family vacation in a relaxed island atmosphere.

main_topic.h_title: Looking for a honeymoon or a luxury vacation? Which five-star hotel in which area would you recommend the best?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: For honeymooners seeking ultimate privacy and a romantic atmosphere, the Conrad area or the Tallingam Beach area are highly recommended. These areas are far from the hustle and bustle, with mostly cliff-like terrain, allowing many five-star hotels to boast breathtaking ocean views overlooking the Gulf of Thailand, and even offering stunning sunsets directly from their rooms. While transportation may be less convenient, these hotels typically feature top-notch spas, private infinity pools, and diverse restaurants. This hotel-as-a-tour model is perfect for those who want to completely unwind and enjoy a luxurious vacation in Koh Samui.

main_topic.h_title: If you like artsy or local styles, are there any boutique hotels in Koh Samui?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: If you prefer something different from the standardized feel of large chain hotels, Koh Samui offers many unique boutique hotels, primarily concentrated around Fisherman's Village (Bophut). These hotels are smaller in scale but boast striking designs, often blending traditional Thai craftsmanship with modern minimalism. The advantage of staying in this area is excellent accessibility; you're within walking distance of trendy restaurants, cafes, and handicraft shops. These hotels typically have a limited number of rooms, resulting in more refined and personalized service. For those who appreciate aesthetics and enjoy taking photos, staying in a boutique hotel near Fisherman's Village will undoubtedly elevate the quality of your social media posts.

main_topic.h_title: What are the transportation options and costs from Koh Samui Airport to your hotel?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: Koh Samui Airport is a private airport operated by Bangkok Airways, and airport transportation costs are relatively high. The most common way is to book a hotel shuttle service, which costs around 600 to 800 baht but is the most time-saving and convenient. To save money, you can buy minibus tickets at the airport counter for about 150 to 300 baht per person depending on the distance, but this requires taking a longer route to pick up other passengers. Alternatively, you can use Grab, but be aware that off-duty taxis may be restricted from entering the airport area at certain times. It's recommended to check with your hotel about shuttle service before checking in to avoid the hassle of waiting for a ride with heavy luggage in the tropical climate.

main_topic.h_title: Are there any affordable and high-quality options in Koh Samui for budget-conscious people looking to save money?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: Even on a budget, you can still stay stylish in Koh Samui! Within the Chaweng and Lamai areas, there are many affordable options hidden in the alleyways, offering modern, designer guesthouses for under 1000 baht per night. These guesthouses often feature lounges and poolside areas, perfect for meeting travelers from around the world. If you don't mind walking 10 to 15 minutes to the beach, accommodations further from the first-row ocean views will be half the price. Additionally, the Mae Nam Beach in the north has many family-run bungalows at relatively low prices, a secret base for experiencing the authentic Koh Samui lifestyle while saving money.

main_topic.h_title: Which hotel areas are conveniently located near popular attractions?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: When choosing accommodation, it's recommended to select options centered around nearby attractions such as the Big Buddha Temple or the Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks. Staying in the Bophut or Cheong Mun area in the northeast of Koh Samui offers quick access to the Big Buddha, Kwan Im Thong, and Fisherman's Village; while staying in Lamai in the southeast provides closer proximity to the Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks and the Guan Gong Temple. Koh Samui actually has a ring road, which takes about 1.5 to 2 hours to cycle around by motorbike. For better accessibility, it's advisable to choose a location in the middle of Chaweng Beach, as this is not only the island's hub but also a reasonable 30-minute drive from the pier for island hopping north or exploring the tropical jungle south.

main_topic.h_title: What are some things to keep in mind when booking a hotel in Koh Samui through a booking website?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: When booking through Agoda or Booking.com, be sure to pay attention to any hidden taxes listed by the hotel. Thailand typically charges an additional 7% business tax and a 10% service charge. Also, check if the hotel offers island shuttle service or free parking; this is crucial for those planning to rent a car. As Koh Samui is a popular tourist destination, prices double and rooms are hard to find during the peak season from December to April, so it's recommended to book at least three months in advance. Finally, carefully review reviews regarding water pressure and Wi-Fi stability to avoid older facilities, ensuring a smooth check-in and creating a perfect list of recommended hotels.

main_topic.h_title: What are some special things to keep in mind when checking into a hotel or villa in Koh Samui?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: When checking into a hotel in Koh Samui, here are a few things to keep in mind. First, the island's power supply can sometimes experience brief fluctuations due to afternoon thunderstorms; this is normal for island tourists, so don't panic. Most hotels require a deposit upon check-in, so it's advisable to have cash or a credit card with sufficient credit. Many resorts no longer proactively provide disposable toiletries, so it's recommended to bring your own toothbrush and toothpaste. Also, if you find seashells or coral on the beach, please leave them where they are and don't take them away. Finally, hotels can usually arrange motorbike rentals or tours at reasonable prices and with better guarantees; if you have any problems, just ask the front desk for help.

main_topic.h_title: What are the best places to stay in Koh Samui?

main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: There are many five-star resorts in Koh Samui, Thailand, which has always been the first choice for many island vacations and weddings. Most of them are concentrated in the beach area in the northeastern half. The accommodation area is divided into Chaweng Beach, Choeng Mon Beach, Mae Nam Beach, There are six major areas: Pop Beach, Lamai Beach, and Panka Beach.

・Chaweng Beach: The most lively commercial district and the longest fine white sand beach on the island, Chaweng Street is the most lively nightlife on the island｜ Accommodation recommendations｜Chaweng Beach Star Hotel
・Cengmon Beach: A quiet beach resort in the northeast corner of Koh Samui, with a number of luxury-level star-rated resorts.
・Mae Nam Beach: The northern coastline of Koh Samui, next to Bophut Beach, overlooking Koh Phangan, which is famous for its full moon party.
・Poput Beach: The beach is only about 2 kilometers long. It has a quiet environment away from the hustle and bustle. It is close to the Fisherman's Village Market and Fisherman's Wharf.

main_topic.h_title: Accommodation features and choices of Samui Chaweng Beach?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: Chaweng Beach is located on the east coastline of Koh Samui, close to Samui International Airport. It has the most lively business district and the longest fine white sandy beach on the island. Chaweng Main Street is the most lively nightlife on the island. Accommodations along the beach can enjoy long stretches of white sand and lively nightlife. The best choice for a first visit to Koh Samui.

main_topic.h_title: Accommodation features and choices of Mae Nam Beach in Koh Samui?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: Mae Nam Beach is located on the northern coastline of Koh Samui, next to Bophut Beach, looking at Koh Phangan, famous for the Full Moon Party. The sand cape at the junction of the two beaches is the W Hotel, a well-known landmark in Koh Samui. It has a place suitable for enjoying the sunset and sunrise. Excellent location.

main_topic.h_title: Accommodation features and choices of Samui Bophut Beach?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: Bophut Beach is only about 2 kilometers long and is adjacent to Chao Nam Beach. It has a peaceful environment away from the hustle and bustle. It is adjacent to the Fisherman’s Village Night Market and there are also places suitable for snorkeling.

main_topic.h_title: Accommodation features and choices in Samui Panka Beach?
main_topic.main_title: 2026｜Summary of Newly Opened Hotels in Koh Samui
main_topic.author: 布萊恩

primary_content.text: Panka Beach is located in the southwest corner of Koh Samui. It has a peaceful beach holiday atmosphere, can enjoy the quiet and sparsely populated sandy beach, and is the best place to enjoy the sunset.
